bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to workforce development; appropriating money for a statewide education campaign to inform employers about the benefits of second-chance hiring.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; SECOND-CHANCE HIRING EDUCATION CAMPAIGN.

$200,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $200,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the workforce development fund to the commissioner of employment and economic development for a statewide education campaign to inform employers about the benefits of second-chance hiring, including incentives available under state and federal law for employing people with a conviction record. This campaign must include creating an informational website and staffing a hotline service. This is a onetime appropriation.
additions: $200,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $200,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the workforce development fund to the commissioner of employment and economic development for a statewide education campaign to inform employers about the benefits of second-chance hiring, including incentives available under state and federal law for employing people with a conviction record. This campaign must include creating an informational website and staffing a hotline service. This is a onetime appropriation.
